manual_coverage.method: Individual visual inspection of each physical page 19 through 38 using view_image with detail original, from the frozen final PDF rendered by system Poppler at 150 dpi. Checked equations, captions, tables, figure labels, clipping, overlaps, page breaks and density after reflow. No blocking defects found.

Individually viewed all eighteen final physical pages 79 through 96 with view_image(detail="original") at original PNG resolution. The images were rendered at 150 dpi by system Poppler from the frozen 103-page snapshot. Checked equations, exact-integer tables, margins, headings, footers, density, overlaps and clipping. The Chapter 22 final paragraph now fits on physical page 79, resolving the preliminary one-line spill. No blocking layout defects remain on the viewed pages.

Every final physical page 39-58 viewed individually using view_image with detail=original from immutable 150 dpi system-Poppler PNGs. Checked equations, tables, captions, legibility, page breaks, density, clipping and overlap. Fresh final-snapshot inspection, not migrated approval from earlier renders.

Individually viewed all 18 actual full-page PNGs through tools.view_image(detail="original"); 150 dpi genuine /usr/bin/pdftoppm render of the final immutable snapshot. Cover, frontmatter, all TOC pages, text, equations, Figures 2.1/3.1 and page breaks inspected. No montage substituted for an individual page.

Re-viewed each final 150-DPI page PNG individually at original resolution using view_image, including all text, equations, captions, tables, headers and footers; inspected for clipping, collisions, missing glyphs, legibility and claim-scope display. Not a contact-sheet-only inspection.
Each final150dpi page image viewed individually at original resolution. Checked equations, source/citation text, code blocks, bibliography readability, margins and footer separation.

Individually inspected final immutable150dpi system-Poppler page PNGs at original resolution. Checked figure labels, mathematical captions, scope restrictions, source page, margins and footers. Supplemental review to the visual author's full page coverage.
All final pages visually inspected directly or transferred from a byte-identical inspected 150dpi render. Per-page evidence in evidence/VISUAL_LAYOUT_QA.json.

scope: Every page of both final readers has an actual visual review record. Scientific data, proof and external source audits are separate records.
